terms.definition: Frappe HRMS Shift Type DocType defining recurring shift start/end times and grace rules.
terms.label: Shift Type

terms.definition: Frappe HRMS Shift Assignment DocType assigning an employee to a shift type over a date range.
terms.label: Shift Assignment

terms.definition: Frappe HRMS Attendance DocType recording an employee's posted daily attendance status.
terms.label: Attendance

terms.definition: Frappe HRMS Employee Checkin DocType recording raw IN/OUT device/kiosk logs.
terms.label: Employee Checkin

terms.definition: Frappe HRMS Attendance Request DocType requesting manual attendance correction or WFH.
terms.label: Attendance Request

terms.definition: Frappe HRMS Leave Type DocType defining leave category flags (carry-forward, encashment, LWP).
terms.label: Leave Type

terms.definition: Frappe HRMS Leave Policy DocType grouping annual leave entitlement allocations.
terms.label: Leave Policy

terms.definition: Frappe HRMS Leave Allocation DocType granting leave days to an employee for a period.
terms.label: Leave Allocation

terms.definition: Frappe HRMS Leave Ledger Entry DocType recording immutable leave balance credits and debits.
terms.label: Leave Ledger Entry

terms.definition: Frappe HRMS Leave Application DocType submitting an employee leave request for approval.
terms.label: Leave Application

terms.definition: Frappe HRMS Compensatory Leave Request DocType claiming comp-off for holiday work.
terms.label: Compensatory Leave Request

terms.definition: Frappe HRMS Leave Encashment DocType converting unused leave balance into pay.
terms.label: Leave Encashment

terms.definition: Frappe HRMS Salary Component DocType defining earning/deduction pay components.
terms.label: Salary Component

terms.definition: Frappe HRMS Salary Structure DocType composing pay components and formulas.
terms.label: Salary Structure

terms.definition: Frappe HRMS Salary Structure Assignment DocType assigning a structure and base salary effective from a date.
terms.label: Salary Structure Assignment

terms.definition: Frappe HRMS Payroll Entry DocType orchestrating batch payslip generation and bank disbursement.
terms.label: Payroll Entry

terms.definition: Frappe HRMS Salary Slip DocType representing an employee's itemized pay statement.
terms.label: Salary Slip

terms.definition: Frappe HRMS Additional Salary DocType applying one-off or recurring bonus/deduction adjustments.
terms.label: Additional Salary

terms.definition: Frappe HRMS Income Tax Slab DocType defining progressive statutory tax brackets.
terms.label: Income Tax Slab

terms.definition: Frappe HRMS Gratuity DocType calculating statutory end-of-service indemnity.
terms.label: Gratuity

terms.definition: Frappe HRMS Expense Claim DocType submitting itemized employee expenses for reimbursement.
terms.label: Expense Claim

terms.definition: Frappe HRMS Employee Advance DocType issuing cash advances against upcoming expenses or salary.
terms.label: Employee Advance

terms.definition: Frappe HRMS Job Opening DocType publishing an open budgeted position.
terms.label: Job Opening

terms.definition: Frappe HRMS Job Applicant DocType tracking a candidate applying to a Job Opening.
terms.label: Job Applicant

terms.definition: Frappe HRMS Interview DocType scheduling and scoring candidate interviews.
terms.label: Interview

terms.definition: Frappe HRMS Job Offer DocType issuing formal employment offer terms to an applicant.
terms.label: Job Offer

terms.definition: Frappe HRMS Employee Onboarding DocType executing new-hire onboarding tasks.
terms.label: Employee Onboarding

terms.definition: Frappe HRMS Employee Transfer DocType transferring an employee across departments/branches.
terms.label: Employee Transfer

terms.definition: Frappe HRMS Employee Promotion DocType recording designation/grade promotion changes.
terms.label: Employee Promotion

terms.definition: Frappe HRMS Employee Separation DocType executing employee exit and offboarding tasks.
terms.label: Employee Separation

terms.definition: Frappe HRMS Appraisal DocType recording periodic employee performance evaluations.
terms.label: Appraisal

terms.definition: Frappe HRMS Goal DocType tracking employee objectives and KRA progress.
terms.label: Goal

terms.definition: Frappe HRMS Training Event DocType scheduling employee training programs.
terms.label: Training Event

terms.definition: Frappe HRMS Training Result DocType recording employee training outcomes.
terms.label: Training Result
